output.description: Moves a DNS zone from the current provider to a new one by creating the zone there, uploading every record except SOA and NS, and then transferring the zone out of the old provider. Sends the record data to the new provider's API, and appends a migration entry to a local ~/.dns_migrations.jsonl log file.
output.declaring_phrase: appends a migration entry to a local ~/.dns_migrations.jsonl log file
